body:
Part of #456 and #326.

Adds a per-user `GraphGoblin.app` for Apple Silicon macOS 15 or later. The installer saves a built checkout and native Node 22 path; a Finder or Dock launch verifies or starts that instance and opens the default browser. Closing the launcher or browser leaves gateway work running. Installation uses a private ownership receipt and atomic publication/replacement; foreign or uncertain destinations refuse.

The Swift engine owns readiness, process lifetime and filesystem admission. Claude-authored AppKit presentation handles progress, Hide, Quit, reopen and the single browser handoff. The API shares its existing bounded gateway log writer across Windows and Darwin adapters, and rechecks the Mac launcher's local key source after both writer leases. Windows log protocol stays at 1; the existing opaque instance protocol stays at 2. No store-format change, automatic updater, login item or PWA-window control.

### Candidate and checks

- Head: `14fd41d3b0a58b0f4dfb4e614c2067d861c29129`; tree: `426f38727cbd3b5f0df8d79bc2dfb93e749d089b`; target: `6d7fcc9838d831fe1be3c3cf52c90a2f33e8f5b1`.
- Local Node 22.23.4 / pnpm 12.8.1: build passed (12 tasks, six cache hits); API source/fixture type check, focused lint and formatting passed. Nine focused API suites passed 177 tests with 19 platform skips; final Darwin adapter suite passed 42 cases. Built-entry checks passed nine tests with six platform skips.
- The original presentation compiled on the owner Mac's Swift 6.3.1 Command Line Tools. Its test target failed with missing `Testing`; no tests ran. The later repeated-Quit correction and integrated native products await hosted compilation. The failure is retained and is not a pass.
- Adds a macOS CI lane for the affected API suites, full Swift tests and public-installer/real-gateway acceptance. Existing Windows, Linux, coverage, browser and image gates are retained.

### Delivery gates still open

Draft: hosted CI, independent native behavior QA, actual Finder/Dock/browser observations, opposite-family reviews and fresh independent Astra MAX audit are pending. Formal scans used: **0 of 3**. GPT 6.1 Sol xhigh implemented backend/native work; actual Claude Code Opus 5.5 xhigh implemented presentation. Claude reviews GPT-owned work, GPT reviews Claude-owned work, and the final audit shares the same scan budget. The owner instance/store/ports and held PR #460 are outside this change.

### Post-merge owner acceptance

Keep #456 and #326 open until the owner records the merged build and observations:

- Open from Finder and a retained Dock pin after a deliberate stop; expect one matching instance and the default browser.
- Reopen while running and while launching; expect the existing instance/state, with no duplicate start.
- Hide progress and reopen it; try Quit during a slow launch and judge the wording and timing.
- Close the launcher and browser during work; expect work to continue. Use the management page's Stop controls to finish it deliberately.
- Update the managed app and exercise the retained alias/pin again.
- Check keyboard navigation, focus, accessibility announcements and failure guidance on the owner's setup.

These owner observations do not replace the pre-merge engineering and independent QA gates.
